日期：2026-01-25T08:00:00Z
主题：Inventory Adjustment Policy
Inventory valuation rules:

1. Variance = Physical Count - System Count
2. Variance within ±2% of system count: minor - auto-adjust
3. Variance over ±2%: major - requires investigation flag
4. Calculate dollar impact: Variance * Unit Cost
5. Items with pending purchase orders (check PO Status column) should be excluded from adjustment
6. Report should include: SKU, item name, system qty, physical qty, variance, dollar impact

- Controller"}
